subject: Engagement stack: Outreach renewal vs Salesloft — decision and negotiation plan
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Engagement stack: Outreach renewal vs Salesloft — decision and negotiation plan

Team,

Our Outreach contract is up for renewal on 2026-11-15 (annual). We need a short, pragmatic plan this week: either (A) renew with improved commercial/contract terms, or (B) start a fast-track migration to Salesloft with a clear cost/time estimate for FY27.

Ask: can each of you send the following by EOD today?
- Monica: 90/60/30-day usage stats (active users, seats, highest-frequency sequences).
- Marcus: rough engineering/CS effort to migrate integrations (SFDC, Sales Engagement API, reporting) and an estimate for peak month migration cost.
- Rishi: any legal procurement pain points we should expect in the vendor T&Cs for renewals (data retention, audit access, subprocessing).

Goal: present recommendation to GTM leads on Monday (2026-10-12). If renewing, I'll ask the vendor to provide a firm best-offer quote and a draft with our preferred redlines. If switching, we'll budget for 3-month migration runway and identify pilot team.

Attachments: current_contract_20230915.pdf (for reference).

Thanks —
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Dir, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement stack: Outreach renewal vs Salesloft — decision and negotiation plan

Stephanie — quick data dump below and attached a CSV with the counts. High level: Outreach is heavily used by SDRs and AEs; usage is concentrated in two sequences (onboarding + re-engagement).

Key metrics (Q3 rolling):
- Active seats: 128 (we currently pay for 150)
- Average daily sends: ~18k emails/day (peaks 28k)
- Top integrations: Salesforce (API), Gong (activity capture), Looker (via export)
- Feature usage: auto-sequences, one-click snippets, meeting links. Engagement tracking for outbound calls is light.

Notes: outreach-specific automation has saved SDR time, but AEs complain about slow mass-send reporting. If we change vendors, we'd need sequencing parity (campaign cloning + meeting links) and a data backfill plan for activity history.

Attachment: Outreach_Q3_usage.csv

—Monica
Monica Patel
Sr. Manager, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-10T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement stack: Outreach renewal vs Salesloft — decision and negotiation plan

Quick technical read:
- Migration scope: sequences (templates + cadence), SFDC activity mapping, meeting sync, and historical activity export (~2 years).
- Estimated effort for a small pilot (10 seats): 3–4 weeks (engineering + CS).
- Full migration (120 seats): ~10–12 weeks with one FTE from engineering + 0.6 FTE from CS during cutover.
- One-time costs (rough): export/mapping scripts + QA — $45k–$70k depending on historical data completeness.

Recommendation: keep renewal conversations open while we get a firm commercial from Outreach. If Outreach can't match a 25–40% delta vs current list pricing for Salesloft + migration credits, escalate to a migration. Also, confirm whether Salesloft will accept our historical activity import at scale — some vendors charge extra for data ingestion.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Eng Manager, Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Kara Thompson <kara.thompson@outreach.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Request: firm renewal quote & commercial flexibility — Redwood account

Kara —

Thanks for your support over the past year. We're evaluating whether to renew Outreach or move to Salesloft. To make an internal recommendation we need a firm proposal from Outreach:

1) A 12-month renewal quote (we currently pay for 150 seats; active seats are 128 — see attached usage). Please include list and net pricing, and any options for seat rebalancing (move to 130/120 seats).
2) One-time migration credit or professional services credit to help with historical activity export/import if we decide to switch later.
3) Contract flexibility: we need to remove the automatic data processing addendum that prevents us from storing a copy of outbound activity for 24 months; our compliance team requires audit export access.
4) Best commercial: our procurement goal is at least 25% off current net vs list. If you can do better, note the limit and any time constraints.

Please send a redlined quote and a PDF we can present to procurement. We are on a tight timeline — need that by end of day Tuesday (2026-10-12).

Attachment: current_contract_20230915.pdf, Outreach_Q3_usage.csv

—Stephanie
From: Kara Thompson <kara.thompson@outreach.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: firm renewal quote & commercial flexibility — Redwood account

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear ask. I've attached a formal renewal quote (renewal_quote_20261012.pdf). Summary upfront: Outreach can offer a 20% net discount off current list for a 12-month renewal and a one-time $25k credit toward professional services or migration support. The pricing is contingent on signing by 2026-11-01.

Regarding contract language: we can provide export access and a scoped audit report, but our standard DPA limits vendor-side historical retention policies. I asked Legal to prepare a redline that makes export and on-demand audit access explicit for Redwood. Expect that in the attached quote PDF.

If 25%+ net is a hard requirement, I don't have authority here to get to 25% today — I can ask for an escalation but would need a fast path to sign (e.g., multi-year or a higher seat commitment).

Attachment: renewal_quote_20261012.pdf

Best,
Kara Thompson
Enterprise Sales Manager | Outreach
Kara.Thompson@outreach.io
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: firm renewal quote & commercial flexibility — Redwood account

Thanks for looping me in. I skimmed the quote and did an initial pass on legal terms. Two items to flag for procurement:

1) Data export & audit: Kara's note is promising but I want the redline in writing. We'll push for explicit language that allows Redwood to extract all outbound activity (email/body/attachments) for 24 months and to use it for internal analytics. If Outreach pushes back, we can request a time-limited escrow for activity exports.

2) Liability & indemnity: current draft limits liability below our preferred threshold. Procurement/legal will ask for a liability cap more aligned to fees paid in the prior 12 months; expect to negotiate.

I'll prepare a short set of redlines (OLG_redlines_20261012.pdf) and loop procurement for commercial negotiation. For the GTM decision: if Outreach is firm at 20% + $25k credit, that might be acceptable if they sign the export/audit language and reduce liability cap. If not, we should proceed with the migration path Marcus outlined.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
